raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`--prefill-decode-interval N` forces N decode-only rounds after every prefill, regardless of how many requests are running. That protects decode ITL once the batch is large, but while the batch is still small it slows its growth: each waiting request waits up to N rounds to be admitted. Throughput-bound deployments (e.g. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with `--max-running-requests 48 --prefill-decode-interval 4`, where TTFT matters less than TPS) want eager admission until the batch is reasonably full, and the interval only after that.

## Modifications

- New flag `--prefill-decode-interval-min-bs` (default `0` = current behavior). The interval only applies while the running batch has at least this many requests.
- Checked in `Scheduler._should_defer_prefill(running_batch)`, not when the interval is armed. Below the threshold, any pending interval is cleared and prefill is admitted. So a batch that shrinks below the threshold mid-interval (requests finishing) resumes admission immediately.
- Under DP attention, arming still uses the globally synchronized `is_extend_in_batch`. The threshold is compared against each rank's own running batch (no running-batch size is synced across ranks). Ranks that differ only resume the existing per-rank admission behavior that applies when the interval is 0, so no new collective or desync is introduced.
- Validation: the new value must be non-negative. Added a row to `server_arguments.mdx`.

Related: #43844 (chunk-only interval protection) also changes this code path. The two policies compose; whichever lands second needs a trivial rebase.

## Accuracy Tests

No model-forward change, only scheduling admission timing.

Unit tests (rx devbox, `lmsysorg/sglang` image with `PYTHONPATH` override at this branch's head, applied on main `d8f85223485`):
- `test_scheduler_prefill_decode_interval.py`, `test_scheduler_hicache_events.py`, `test_scheduler_chunked_req_gate.py`, `test_scheduler_dp_converted_batch_full.py`, `test_server_args_docs_coverage.py`, `test_server_args.py`, `test_model_overrides.py`: **430 passed, 310 subtests passed**. New cases: below threshold admits and clears; at/above threshold defers; shrinking below threshold mid-interval ends it; negative value is rejected.
- `ruff check` (pre-commit rule set) + `ruff format` 0.15.1 + `isort` clean on all changed files.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not yet benchmarked end to end. Expected effect: identical to today when the flag is unset. With it set, at low concurrency the effect is the same as interval 0; near the batch cap it matches the configured interval.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).
